protocol.aggregation: Within each meter, fold scores weighted by target count; then equal weight per meter. MASE denominator is valid training weekly seasonal error.
protocol.bootstrap: 1000 circular moving-block replicates, seven observed days, within fold; all meters share the resampled dates. Daily contrasts differ slightly from observation-weighted primary MASE.
protocol.interval: Symmetric nominal 90% held-out calibration-residual band, clipped at zero. Empirical coverage; temporal dependence precludes a universal guarantee.
protocol.limits: 20 fixed anonymized clients, one provider-clock dataset; future-time evaluation on known clients, not unseen-site generalization. No weather, PV, EV, feeder capacities or fault labels are supplied by UCI.
protocol.missing: Six-hour causal forward fill, then training-only median. Truth is never imputed; unavailable/DST targets excluded.
protocol.origin: At t only readings labelled < t are available; h predicts t+h-1.
protocol.parameters: Fixed before held-out evaluation; no test tuning or random early-stopping validation.
protocol.stress: Controlled input corruption: 5% seeded random loss plus one 24h outage starting on day 21 at 08:00 of every test month. Frozen models and original observed targets.

source.activation_policy: Exclude the initial zero run up to the first positive 2013 training reading; retain all subsequent zero readings. First-training rule only.
source.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of four quarter-hour kW readings per left-labelled source-clock hour. kWh per quarter = kW / 4.
source.clock: Timezone-naive Portuguese provider clock; 96 slots per day even on DST transitions. No UTC conversion.
source.creator: Artur Trindade
source.dst_policy: Exclude whole March/October transition days from targets; treat their historical inputs as unavailable. Also exclude origin-to-target windows crossing those dates.
source.hash_note: Archive hash pinned from the official UCI download; this is a project pin, not a separately published provider checksum.
source.provider_missing_values: Provider reports none. Initial zero runs can encode clients not yet created; later zeros are retained.
source.selection: MT_001–MT_020 in source order; fixed cohort, no test-score selection
